sources.title: Diffusion-generated images sharpen AI detection of faulty power grid
sources.snippet: Researchers combined a conditional diffusion model, a hypertuned YOLO26x detector and a Swin-V2-B classifier with a new SHAP-CAM explainability method to detect and classify faulty power grid insulators, achieving an F1-score of 0.98149 and mAP@ of 0.98951.

sources.title: anilagarwal/swin-t-classification · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Swin T for Classification Overview A small Swin T implementation for Classification, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The small variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.
